faqs.a:
In the event a county-wide sales tax becomes effective in Jefferson County and provisions
               are made for the revenue collections to the city in an amount at least equal to the
               net revenue collections which would be received under the within article, the within
               article shall forthwith be repealed by the city council as of the effective date of
               such county-wide sales tax; providing a repeal of the within article has not taken
               place.
(Code 1981, § 31-71; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
